details.method: Meta-model module selection matches Transformers bitsandbytes conversion; unique parameters count tied weights once
details.int8: One byte per quantized weight plus one FP32 row scale per output feature
details.nf4: Two packed weights per uint8, one FP32 scale per 64 weights, and a 16-entry FP32 codebook per converted module; double quantization disabled
details.unquantized: Embeddings, skipped linear modules, biases and nonlinear parameters keep their configured loading dtype; model buffers retain their construction dtype
details.loading: Largest original converted linear tensor; INT8 allows both the staged input and its FP16 quantizer copy, NF4 allows the staged input. Transformers loads on-the-fly quantization synchronously
details.scope: Base tensor storage estimate only; excludes adapter, decision head, allocator overhead, CUDA context, quantizer workspace and inference activations

quantization_validation.verification: Exact planned modules, dimensions, packed weight dtypes and quantizer state checked before LoRA attachment

backend.int8_activation_cast: BF16 activations cast to FP16 by bitsandbytes; cast message logged once
backend.selection: argmax calibrated choice logits; first option wins exact ties
backend.timing_scope: synchronized backbone forward, FP32 decision head and softmax; excludes tokenization, input transfer, output transfer, and model loading
backend.memory_scope: PyTorch CUDA device 0 peak allocated/reserved bytes including all resident weights, with the unused language-model head
